name: Chav
description: Chav was the tenth and last planet of the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A world made of barren rock, it had two moons and orbited the star Domir.
lead_paragraphs: Chav was the tenth and last planet of the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A world made of barren rock, it had two moons and orbited the star Domir.
